about: The models behind Fight Health Insurance, for the About Our AI page. Add a model or judge with a new entry; a model's routed_as is the name the model router knows it by, blank for ours and for Jev; retire one by setting retired and retired_reason, never by deleting it. While show_details is false, a model we run ourselves (ours: true) is shown as an FHI model with no base model, maker or setup, and the tests, judges and changes marked detail stay off the page; true shows them. Totals only: no letters, denials or patient details.
